report.title: Philadelphia Eagles at Dallas Cowboys, Week 12 Scouting Report
report.summary: Dallas leans on a pass-heavy attack built on motion and play action, with Lamb and Pickens doing most of the work. Its defense is weak against the pass, on third down and in the red zone, while its run defense is steadier. Special teams look even, so field position and long field goals could decide a close game. Injuries to Dallas's starting guard and back-end players should open up the middle and the secondary.

sections.heading: Opponent offense
sections.body: Dallas leans pass early, dropping back on 59.2% [oc1] of early-down snaps over 561 plays [oc2], and on 81.8% [oc3] of third-and-long snaps over 44 plays [oc4], though that is a small sample. Passing drives the offense at 0.18 EPA per pass play [oc7] versus 0.04 per run [oc8], with a 49.9% [oc9] success rate that ranks 5th [oc10] in the league. Runs go middle 39.0% [oc11], left 37.1% [oc12] and right 23.9% [oc13]. Expect pre-snap motion on 47.2% [oc15] of plays and play action on 24.0% [oc16] of dropbacks. Lamb takes 32.4% [oc21] of targets and Pickens 22.0% [oc22], 54.4% [oc23] combined, at an average depth of target of 8.5 [oc24] yards. Explosive plays come on 8.3% [oc25] of pass plays. Dallas scores on 73.9% [oc27] of red-zone drives over 46 drives [oc28].

sections.heading: Opponent defense
sections.body: Dallas blitzes on 21.9% [dc1] of dropbacks over 401 plays [dc2], 29th-highest in the league [dc3], and averages 4.2 [dc4] pass rushers per dropback. The defense allows 0.11 EPA per play [dc7], 30th in the league [dc8], and explosive pass plays at 9.5% [dc10]. The run defense is steadier at 0.04 EPA per run allowed [dc13]. On third down Dallas allows conversions on 48.5% [dc16] of 136 plays [dc17], ranking 32nd [dc18], and red-zone drives end in touchdowns 65.1% [dc19] of the time over 43 drives [dc20]. Philadelphia's play action ranks 26th [dc22] and its RPOs 9th [dc24]. Expect Philadelphia to stay run-first on early downs, with third-and-long looks as the main threat against a light box.

sections.heading: Special teams
sections.body: Dallas's only kicker is B.Aubrey, who has made 20 [kc1] of 25 [kc2] field goals, 80.0% [kc3], with a long make of 60.0 [kc4] yards. Accuracy falls on long tries, to 50.0% [kc5] on 10 [kc6] attempts, so force Dallas to earn points from deep. Punting is average, with a net average of 42.4 [kc7] yards and 53.8% [kc9] of punts pinned deep, so expect field position near midfield. Touchbacks are rare at 14.1% [kc10] on 71 [kc11] kickoffs, and coverage allows 20.1 [kc12] yards per return on 54 [kc13]. Dallas's punt return unit averages 6.6 [kc14] yards on 29 [kc15] returns, so kicking away from the returner gains little. Special-teams EPA is 0.00 [kc16] per play on 309 [kc17] plays for Dallas and 0.00 [kc18] on 269 [kc19] for Philadelphia, so the units are even. Take points when Dallas is forced long, and don't give up a short field to chase a stop.

sections.heading: Injuries and availability
sections.body: Tight end Jake Ferguson is Out after drawing 6.6% [ic2] of Dallas targets over 410 [ic3] team targets and averaging 56.4% [ic4] of snaps per game across 9 [ic5] games, so expect backups to absorb his routes. Wide receiver Jonathan Mingo is also Out. Guard Tyler Booker is Out after averaging 94.0% [ic9] of snaps per game, so plan for interior run-blocking changes. Cornerback DaRon Bland and safety P.J. Locke are Out, and safety Jalen Thompson is Questionable. For Philadelphia, receiver Dontayvion Wicks is Out after taking 10.5% [ic14] of targets over 306 [ic15] team targets, running back Will Shipley is Questionable, and linebacker Zack Baun is Out after averaging 92.5% [ic20] of defensive snaps per game. Linebacker Smael Mondon Jr. is Doubtful.

sections.heading: Key matchups
sections.body: The central question is Dallas's passing game against Philadelphia's coverage. Lamb and Pickens take 32.4% [mc1] and 22.0% [mc2] of targets, 54.4% [mc3] combined, at an average depth of 8.5 [mc4] yards. Rotate coverage on motion and keep the safeties from biting on play action, since explosive pass plays come on 8.3% [mc9] of attempts. Dallas runs up the middle on 39.0% [mc10] of designed runs, and with Booker out, interior blocking will change. With Baun out and Mondon Doubtful, keep an extra defender near the box on early downs. Dallas allows conversions on 48.5% [mc12] of third downs over 136 plays [mc13], ranking 32nd [mc14], and red-zone drives end in touchdowns 65.1% [mc15] of the time over 43 drives [mc16]. Philadelphia passes on third-and-long at the 9th-highest rate [mc17] over 72 plays [mc18], so attack the coverage on those downs rather than settle for the run.
